observations.status: scope contract and per-task smoke wording passed

limitations: The scope verifier compares tool names and approval categories but does not establish production authorization, persistence, sink delivery, or provider behavior.
The bounded smoke permits multiple wake-ups and another synthetic task under the documented idempotency and budget controls; no global invocation quota was asserted.
Historical 2026-10-08 tool-count and selection summaries remain unreproducible because raw requests, usage, question mapping, and scorer are unavailable.
method: Reran the issue-scoped offline scope contract after the whole-lesson pass found ambiguous wording that could be read as a global one-run limit. The corrected contract distinguishes one predeclared live smoke case from task wake-ups and additional tasks, and requires per-task/per-response limits. Compiled and executed the scope example in a temporary directory; no provider or network call was made.
